definitions.gloss: batting lineup; the batters as a unit (baseball)
definitions.explanation: A team's batters considered collectively as an offensive unit, especially with regard to their combined hitting power. Literally the "hitting line."

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{打線|だせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: This year's team has a strong batting lineup.

examples.japanese: ⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{好投|こうとう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{打線|だせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つながらなかった。
examples.english: Because of the opponent's fine pitching, our lineup couldn't string hits together.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四番|よんばん}→四番：30009_yonban⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{打線|だせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧し、⟦{一気|いっき}→一気：08891_ikki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{十点|じってん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: With the cleanup hitter at its center, the lineup exploded and scored ten runs in a burst.

notes:
A baseball term. It treats the batting order as a single force rather than individual hitters, so it collocates with words for strength, connecting hits, and scoring.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {打線|だせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つながる: the lineup strings hits together
- {打線|だせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{爆発|ばくはつ}→爆発：03575_bakuhatsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: the lineup explodes (for many runs)
- ⟦{強力|きょうりょく}→強力：02656_kyouryoku⟧{打線|だせん}: a powerful batting lineup
- {打線|だせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{湿|しめ}る→湿る：13323_shimeru_damp⟧: the lineup goes cold

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {打順|だじゅん}: batting order — the sequence in which batters come up, rather than their collective power
